profile: one-versus-all classification: a multi-class classification strategy that learns C two-class classifiers over the entire dataset, with the cth classifier trained to distinguish the cth class from the remainder of the data. This approach is also called one-versus-rest. It can also be applied to tune individual columns of a weight matrix one at a time.
